ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms deprecated APIs, replacement owners and the deadline-handling flag are declared; it does not show the migration is done.
offer: Identify each deprecated API and assign a migration owner. Removal deadlines remain explicit; warning suppression is not a substitute for replacing a disappearing dependency.

minimal.reason: List each deprecated API in use by name and version. A missing list means a disappearing dependency goes unnoticed, so enumerate them.

mid.reason: Name an owner for each replacement. Unowned migrations stall until removal breaks the build, so assign a person or team.

maximal.reason: Set ignoring the removal deadline to false. Suppressing a warning does not stop the dependency disappearing, so track the removal date explicitly.
